review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Right vertices with identical nonempty left-neighbor sets always contribute together. Inclusion-exclusion over queried left subsets recovers each such class sum, so the gcd of all union sums equals the gcd of these class sums. Empty-neighbor vertices never contribute; exact sorted tuples avoid hash-collision logic.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
